args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: All production regions now run **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Deployment history also ruled out v2.3.1-rc (unhealthy in staging) as an option.
3. **Verified health**: checkout-api is now healthy in all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** is open for checkout-api, documenting the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.

The incident notes that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of its health check failures is identified.
